transcript.text: Just got a new Siemens dishwasher and there's always a bit of water left in the bottom under the filter after it finishes. Is it draining properly?

Yes — if it is only a small amount of clean water sitting in the sump underneath the filter, that is normal and usually means it has drained properly. Dishwashers retain a little water there to keep pump and door seals from drying out. It becomes a drainage concern if the water is dirty or smelly, rises above the filter, covers the tub base, or the machine leaves water after cancelling a programme. Is it only a small, clean amount below the filter level?
Yes, it's a small amount of clean water, about a cupful, sitting in the sump under the filter. None in the main tub. Thanks for explaining!

You’re welcome. With a small amount of clean water contained below the filter and none left in the tub, it is behaving normally; no action is needed. Only investigate if it becomes dirty or smelly, rises above the filter level, or starts remaining in the main tub.
